requirements_addressed: Support NATS_CREDS env var for optional credentials
Log every action with prefixed format: [CREATE], [UPDATE], [OK], [ERROR]
Use set -euo pipefail for strict error handling
Handle update failures gracefully (log and continue)
Wait for NATS health before attempting provisioning
Print summary at end: N created, M updated, K already current, E errors

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script reads all streams from stream-definitions.json
completion_promises.evidence: Script uses jq to parse stream-definitions.json, checks jq availability with 'command -v jq', iterates over .streams[] array extracting all 7 fields (name, subjects, retention, max_age, max_msgs, storage, replicas). Validated by 12 tests in TestReadsStreamDefinitions class.

completion_promises.criterion_text: First run creates all 7 streams successfully
completion_promises.evidence: Script uses 'nats stream add <NAME> --defaults' to create streams that don't exist. Checks stream existence with 'nats stream info <NAME> --json' first. Logs [CREATE] prefix on creation. Validated by 4 tests in TestStreamCreation class.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Second run detects existing streams and reports [OK] or [UPDATE] (no errors)
completion_promises.evidence: Script checks if stream exists via 'nats stream info', then compares config to detect changes. Reports [OK] for current streams and [UPDATE] for streams that need updating. Validated by TestIdempotencyDetection class (2 tests).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Changing a value in JSON (e.g., max_age) propagates on next run via [UPDATE]
completion_promises.evidence: Script uses 'nats stream update <NAME> --force' to apply changes to existing streams. The needs_update() function compares current stream config with desired values to detect changes. Validated by TestStreamUpdate class (3 tests).

completion_promises.criterion_text: --dry-run flag shows planned actions without modifying anything
completion_promises.evidence: Script accepts --dry-run flag, sets DRY_RUN=true, and gates all nats stream add/update commands behind DRY_RUN check. In dry-run mode, logs [DRY-RUN] with what would happen. Skips NATS health check in dry-run mode. Validated by TestDryRunFlag class (3 tests).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Script exits 0 when all streams provisioned, non-zero only on fatal errors
completion_promises.evidence: Script exits 0 on success (including when some streams have non-fatal errors). Exits non-zero (exit 1) only for fatal errors: missing jq, missing nats CLI, missing stream-definitions.json, or NATS server unreachable. Uses 'continue' pattern for per-stream error handling. Validated by TestExitCodeBehavior class (3 tests).

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: bash -n syntax check passes. Python test file compiles with py_compile. Shell script follows consistent formatting with proper quoting, error handling, and structure.
